display_name: Deliver a background job completion to its role inbox
description: Push a finished asynchronous job outcome into the durable role inbox stamped on its originating fleet flow, while retaining job_service pull recovery. Role delivery is persist-first and completion_reach is stamped only after the measured hand-off. The returned drive_on_delivery value describes the separate attempt to nudge the current role holder: not_managed for a completed no-row lookup, ineligible_state for a non-driveable managed lifecycle, driver_unavailable when state or channel resolution is unavailable, and driver_scheduled when the completion notice was queued on the bounded delivery-drive executor without waiting for it; that drive's finished driver_sent or driver_error is logged against the message_id. driver_queue_full means the bounded drive queue was at its cap, so no notice was queued; the message itself is still durable. A queued drive re-checks the recipient's lifecycle before touching its pane, so a recipient parked or retired meanwhile logs ineligible_state instead of driver_sent. Neither shows that a model turn began or that the completion was consumed. Registered calls return a persisted data.job_id and data.status=queued before payload formatting, serialization or delivery. The existing serial messaging owner retains the action-owned arguments only in a local closure; the persisted request is a bounded public operation descriptor, never the full payload. Read job_service.get_job by that exact id for the complete former response in job.result and typed failure in job.error. A vanished bridge retains dropped_bridge_gone. Terminal delivery jobs never send another role-completion notification. Volatile arguments cannot be reconstructed after worker/runtime loss; reconcile uncertain effects and never replay automatically. Direct Python callers retain synchronous complete results.
embedding_description: Deliver a background job completion to the originating durable role, preserve get_job and unreached-drain recovery, and expose managed wake disposition. Relevant outcomes are not_managed, ineligible_state, driver_unavailable, driver_scheduled, and driver_queue_full; a scheduled drive is a queued notice, not worker consumption.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Job completion delivered to role inbox
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Admission returns data.job_id and data.status=queued. Retrieve the exact job until terminal; job.result contains the complete delivery response including thread_id, message_id, delivery, reach_stamped, resolved recipient and drive_on_delivery. Admission does not establish delivery or consumption.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the persisted job id as admission. Schedule exact-id get_job retrieval; distinguish terminal job status, durable inbox hand-off and the independent managed-driver disposition. Never replay a delivery whose outcome is uncertain.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Routes an already-persisted terminal job payload to its stamped durable role, records completion reach, and emits a distinct managed-driver diagnostic for the holder.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_arguments, peer_role_vacant, peer_role_malformed, bridge.not_running, and state_service_unavailable prevent or invalidate push routing, but the terminal job row remains retrievable. drive_on_delivery values not_managed, ineligible_state, driver_unavailable, driver_scheduled, and driver_queue_full belong to successful delivery results and do not alter job persistence; driver_scheduled is not consumption proof.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Recover the terminal payload with job_service::get_job or list_unreached_job_completions rather than re-running the job. Restore a vacant or malformed completion role for later pushes. If the envelope persisted but drive_on_delivery is not_managed, ineligible_state, or driver_unavailable, or a scheduled drive logs driver_error, notify the holder through an independently verified route; after driver_scheduled, wait for explicit uptake evidence before marking the completion acted upon.
